unit.why: After a short laudatory introduction, the division tells one complete tale about R. Shimshon Wertheimer of Vienna, a non-Hasidic court rabbi. He exposes a forged divorce obtained by a suitor who wanted to marry a deserted wife.
unit.boundary_note: opens with a brief editorial preface introducing the cycle of stories about R. Shimshon of Vienna

stories.end_quote: עשה הדבר הזה ועתה יגרש לבז
stories.summary_en: A wealthy man's scholarly son-in-law flees after quarrels with his wife. A lustful suitor, sent to find him, buys a false divorce from an impostor, and R. Shimson of Vienna perceives the fraud. He brings the real husband to the wedding and unmasks the groom under the canopy.
